title: Directional Revision under Two-Horizon Deliberation: A Revealed-Preference Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.23781v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study deterministic choice when the same decision maker is observed before and after a deliberative intervention that makes one of two fixed ordinal consequence dimensions more salient. Both choice modes are path independent. Ordinary choice respects two-dimensional dominance, while any binary reversal under fuller deliberation must favor the alternative that is strictly better on the emphasized dimension. We characterize exactly the admissible ordinary and full-horizon rankings. The characterization yields a protected partial order, sharp pairwise and menu-level identification, a signed restriction on menu-level choice changes, and an acyclicity test for incomplete observations. With an ordered sequence of deliberative modes, choices from any fixed menu form a monotone tradeoff path: every switch improves the emphasized dimension, worsens the other dimension, and an abandoned alternative cannot reappear. translated_title: 双期审议下的方向性修正：一项揭示偏好分析
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究当同一决策者在审议干预前后被观察时的确定性选择，该干预使得两个固定序数后果维度之一更加突出。两种选择模式都是路径独立的。普通选择尊重二维优势，而在更充分审议下的任何二元反转必须偏好于在强调维度上严格更优的备选方案。我们精确刻画了可允许的普通和全期排名。该刻画产生了一个受保护的偏序、尖锐的成对和菜单级识别、菜单级选择变化的符号约束，以及针对不完整观察的无环性检验。对于有序的审议模式序列，任何固定菜单上的选择形成一条单调权衡路径：每次切换改善强调维度、恶化另一维度，且被放弃的备选方案不会重新出现。当强调的结果被...
tldr: 本文通过揭示偏好分析，刻画了双期审议下决策者选择修正的允许排名，并提出了可检验的单调权衡路径和无环性条件。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes admissible rankings under two-horizon deliberation via revealed preferences, yielding a protected partial order, monotone tradeoff paths, and an acyclicity test.
